definition.content:
## Cyberhaven Events
*Raw activity observed by endpoint, browser and cloud sensors*

This dashboard provides complete visibility into raw data-movement / DLP events observed by Cyberhaven sensors (endpoint, browser, cloud): actions, destinations, users, hosts, data volume and content inspection.

Data source: Cyberhaven Event streaming destination (`source:cyberhaven cyberhaven.logtype:cyberhaven-events`).

**Tips**
- Use the filters at the top (Action-Kind, Sensor-Kind, Destination-Sensitivity, User, Blocked-Allowed, Host, Destination-Channel, Cyberhaven-Tenant) to narrow every panel.
- Use the timeframe selector in the upper-right corner to change the default timeframe.
- Clone this dashboard to rearrange, modify, and add widgets.
High-level view of Cyberhaven data-movement events: totals, blocked events, unique users and hosts, data volume, and trends over time.
